title: Window or door type
text: uPVC, aluminium, timber, sash and composite units all use different hardware and glazing methods.

title: Nature of the fault
text: A stiff handle is a different job from a dropped sash, a failed sealed unit or a split frame.

title: Parts and materials
text: Some repairs use standard hardware; others need unit-specific or made-to-measure components.

title: Complexity of the repair
text: Multi-point mechanisms, period joinery and large glazed units take longer and need more care.

title: Access and property requirements
text: Upper floors, restricted access and occupied commercial premises affect how the work is planned.
